**1) Receipt Drop Shadows:**
Yes. The receipts in Img3 feature a hard, solid black offset drop shadow that precisely follows the irregular zigzag/torn edge of the paper tickets. This creates a distinct "sticker" or physical layer effect against the dark background.

**2) Executable Ratio Prominence:**
Yes. In the execution console (Img2), the **0.7657** value is highly prominent. It is rendered in bold ink (black) text inside a bright lime-green highlight pill, making it the primary focal point of the stats section and the order form header.

**3) Visual Bugs & Legibility:**
*   **No Overlaps/Clipping:** All elements are well-spaced. The SVG illustration in Img1 is clean; the form fields in Img2 have proper padding; the receipt text in Img3 is fully contained within the ticket boundaries.
*   **Legibility:** Text is crisp across all three screens. The monospaced data on the receipts and the high-contrast headers are easily readable.
*   **Minor Note:** The "SETTLED" stickers on the receipts in Img3 are rotated slightly, which looks intentional for the "physical ticket" aesthetic rather than a bug.

***

### Overall Verdict: **SHIP**

The design system (bone/ink/lime) is applied consistently. The specific visual requirements—the hard-edged receipt shadows and the highlighted executable ratio—are implemented correctly. The UI is polished with no critical visual defects.
